services.desc: They are located one mile apart in the heart of Doylestown, PA, and you will need to buy a separate ticket for each. Please read about each castle below to ensure you are selecting the correct one before you purchase your ticket. The last tour of the day usually begins at 4:00 p.m. and is subject to change. Tour times are located at our ticketing button below. Plan to arrive 10 minutes prior to your tour’s start time and check-in at the Fonthill Castle Welcome
